articles.title_en: New Frontiers: The Origins and Content of New Work, 1940–2018
articles.title_cn: 新前沿：新工作的起源与内容，1940-2018
articles.abstract_en: We answer three core questions about the hypothesized role of newly emerging job categories (“new work”) in counterbalancing the erosive effect of task-displacing automation on labor demand: what is the substantive content of new work, where does it come from, and what effect does it have on labor demand? We construct a novel database spanning eight decades of new job titles linked to U.S. Census microdata and to patent-based measures of occupations’ exposure to labor-augmenting and labor-automating innovations. The majority of current employment is in new job specialties introduced since 1940, but the locus of new-work creation has shifted from middle-paid production and clerical occupations over 1940–1980 to high-paid professional occupations and secondarily to low-paid services since 1980. New work emerges in response to technological innovations that complement the outputs of occupations and demand shocks that raise occupational demand. Innovations that automate tasks or reduce occupational demand slow new-work emergence. Although the flow of augmentation and automation innovations is positively correlated across occupations, the former boosts occupational labor demand while the latter depresses it. The demand-eroding effects of automation innovations have intensified in the past four decades while the demand-increasing effects of augmentation innovations have not.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们回答了关于新兴职业类别（“新工作”）在抵消任务替代型自动化对劳动力需求的侵蚀作用方面所假设角色的三个核心问题：新工作的实质性内容是什么，它来自哪里，以及它对劳动力需求有何影响？我们构建了一个跨越八十年新职业头衔的新数据库，并将其与美国人口普查微观数据以及基于专利的职业暴露于劳动增强型和劳动自动化型创新的度量联系起来。自1940年以来，当前就业的大部分集中在新的职业专业中，但新工作创造的场所已从1940-1980年间的中等收入生产和文职职业转移到1980年以来的高收入专业职业，其次为低收入服务业。新工作的出现是对补充职业产出的技术创新和提高职业需求的需求冲击的回应。自动化任务或降低职业需求的创新减缓了新工作的出现。尽管增强型和自动化型创新的流动在职业间呈正相关，但前者提升了职业劳动力需求，而后者则抑制了它。自动化创新的需求侵蚀效应在过去四十年中加剧，而增强型创新的需求增加效应并未如此。

articles.title_en: The Ant and the Grasshopper: Seasonality and the Invention of Agriculture
articles.title_cn: 蚂蚁与蚱蜢：季节性及农业的发明
articles.abstract_en: The Neolithic revolution saw the independent development of agriculture among at least seven unconnected hunter-gatherer populations. I propose that the rapid spread of agricultural techniques resulted from increased climatic seasonality causing hunter-gatherers to adopt a sedentary lifestyle and store food for the season of scarcity. Their newfound sedentary lifestyle and storage habits facilitated the invention of agriculture. I present a model and support it with global climate data and Neolithic adoption dates, showing that greater seasonality increased the likelihood of agriculture’s invention and its speed of adoption by neighbors. This study suggests that seasonality patterns played a dominant role in determining our species’ transition to farming.
articles.abstract_cn: 新石器时代革命见证了至少七个互不联系的狩猎采集人群独立发展出农业。我提出，农业技术的迅速传播源于气候季节性的增强，这促使狩猎采集者采取定居生活方式并为匮乏季节储存食物。他们新获得的定居生活方式和储存习惯促进了农业的发明。我提出了一个模型，并用全球气候数据和新石器时代采用日期加以支持，表明更强的季节性增加了农业发明的可能性及其被邻近人群采用的速度。这项研究表明，季节性模式在决定我们物种向农业转变的过程中发挥了主导作用。

articles.title_cn: 工人对外部机会的信念
articles.abstract_en: Standard labor market models assume that workers hold accurate beliefs about the external wage distribution, and hence their outside options with other employers. We test this assumption by comparing German workers’ beliefs about outside options with objective benchmarks. First, we find that workers wrongly anchor their beliefs about outside options on their current wage: workers that would experience a 10% wage change if switching to their outside option only expect a 1% change. Second, workers in low-paying firms underestimate wages elsewhere. Third, in response to information about the wages of similar workers, respondents correct their beliefs about their outside options and change their job search and wage negotiation intentions. Finally, we analyze the consequences of anchoring in a simple equilibrium model. In the model, anchored beliefs keep overly pessimistic workers stuck in low-wage jobs, which gives rise to monopsony power and labor market segmentation.
articles.abstract_cn: 标准劳动力市场模型假设工人对外部工资分布及其在其他雇主处的替代机会持有准确的信念。我们通过将德国工人对外部机会的信念与客观基准进行比较来检验这一假设。首先，我们发现工人错误地将其对外部机会的信念锚定在当前工资上：如果转换到外部机会将经历10%工资变化的工人，仅预期1%的变化。其次，低薪企业的工人低估了其他地方的工资。第三，在收到关于类似工人工资的信息后，受访者纠正了其对外部机会的信念，并改变了其求职和工资谈判意向。最后，我们在一个简单的均衡模型中分析了锚定的后果。在该模型中，锚定的信念使过度悲观的工人困在低薪工作中，从而产生买方垄断力量和劳动力市场分割。

articles.title_en: The Role of the Ask Gap in Gender Pay Inequality
articles.title_cn: 询问差距在性别薪酬不平等中的作用
articles.abstract_en: The gender ask gap measures the extent to which women ask for lower salaries than comparable men. This article studies its role in generating wage inequality, using novel data from an online recruitment platform for full-time engineering jobs: Hired.com. To use the platform, job candidates must post an ask salary, stating how much they want to make in their next job. Firms then apply to candidates by offering them a bid salary, solely based on the candidate’s résumé and ask salary. If the candidate is hired, a final salary is recorded. After adjusting for résumé characteristics, the ask gap is 2.9%, the bid gap is 2.2%, and the final offer gap is 1.4%. Further controlling for the ask salary explains the entirety of the residual gender gaps in bid and final salaries. To further provide evidence of the causal effect of the ask salary on the bid salary, I exploit an unanticipated change in how candidates were prompted to provide their ask. For some candidates in mid-2018, the answer box used to solicit the ask salary was changed from an empty field to an entry prefilled with the median bid salary for similar candidates. I find that this change drove the ask, bid, and final offer gaps to zero. In addition, women did not receive fewer bids or final offers than men did due to the change, suggesting they faced little penalty for demanding comparable wages.
articles.abstract_cn: 性别询问差距衡量的是女性在求职时要求的薪资低于同等条件男性的程度。本文利用来自在线招聘平台Hired.com的全职工程岗位的新数据，研究其在产生工资不平等中的作用。使用该平台时，求职者必须发布一个期望薪资，说明他们在下一份工作中想要多少薪水。然后，公司仅根据求职者的简历和期望薪资，通过提供报价薪资来申请候选人。如果候选人被录用，则会记录最终薪资。在调整简历特征后，询问差距为2.9%，报价差距为2.2%，最终录用薪资差距为1.4%。进一步控制期望薪资可以完全解释报价和最终薪资中剩余的性别差距。为了进一步提供期望薪资对报价薪资因果效应的证据，我利用了候选人被提示提供期望薪资方式的一次意外变化。在2018年年中，对于某些候选人，用于征求期望薪资的答案框从空字段改为预填有类似候选人中位报价薪资的条目。我发现这一变化使询问、报价和最终录用薪资差距降至零。此外，女性并未因这一变化而比男性收到更少的报价或最终录用通知，这表明她们在要求同等薪资时几乎没有受到惩罚。

articles.title_en: Discrimination in Multiphase Systems: Evidence from Child Protection
articles.title_cn: 多阶段系统中的歧视：来自儿童保护的证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop empirical tools for studying discrimination in multiphase systems and apply them to the setting of foster care placement by child protective services. Leveraging the quasi-random assignment of two sets of decision-makers—initial hotline call screeners and subsequent investigators—we study how unwarranted racial disparities arise and propagate through this system. Using a sample of over 200,000 maltreatment allegations, we find that calls involving Black children are 55% more likely to result in foster care placement than calls involving white children with the same potential for future maltreatment in the home. Call screeners account for up to 19% of this unwarranted disparity, with the remainder due to investigators. Unwarranted disparity is concentrated in cases with potential for future maltreatment, suggesting that white children may be harmed by “underplacement” in high-risk situations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了研究多阶段系统中歧视的实证工具，并将其应用于儿童保护服务中的寄养安置情境。利用两组决策者——初始热线电话筛选员和后续调查员——的准随机分配，我们研究了无根据的种族差异如何在该系统中产生并传播。使用超过200,000起虐待指控的样本，我们发现涉及黑人儿童的电话比涉及白人儿童且家庭未来虐待可能性相同的电话，最终导致寄养安置的可能性高出55%。电话筛选员占这种无根据差异的至多19%，其余部分归因于调查员。无根据的差异集中在具有未来虐待可能性的案件中，这表明白人儿童可能在高风险情况下因“安置不足”而受到伤害。

articles.title_en: Identifying Prediction Mistakes in Observational Data
articles.title_cn: 识别观测数据中的预测错误
articles.abstract_en: Decision makers, such as doctors, judges, and managers, make consequential choices based on predictions of unknown outcomes. Do these decision makers make systematic prediction mistakes based on the available information? If so, in what ways are their predictions systematically biased? In this article, I characterize conditions under which systematic prediction mistakes can be identified in empirical settings such as hiring, medical diagnosis, and pretrial release. I derive a statistical test for whether the decision maker makes systematic prediction mistakes under these assumptions and provide methods for estimating the ways the decision maker’s predictions are systematically biased. I analyze the pretrial release decisions of judges in New York City, estimating that at least 20% of judges make systematic prediction mistakes about misconduct risk given defendant characteristics. Motivated by this analysis, I estimate the effects of replacing judges with algorithmic decision rules and find that replacing judges with algorithms where systematic prediction mistakes occur dominates the status quo.
articles.abstract_cn: 决策者，如医生、法官和管理者，基于对未知结果的预测做出重要选择。这些决策者是否会根据现有信息犯系统性的预测错误？如果是，他们的预测在哪些方面存在系统性偏差？在本文中，我刻画了在招聘、医疗诊断和审前释放等实证环境中识别系统性预测错误的条件。我在这些假设下推导了一个统计检验，用于判断决策者是否犯系统性预测错误，并提供了估计决策者预测系统性偏差方式的方法。我分析了纽约市法官的审前释放决定，估计至少20%的法官在根据被告特征预测不当行为风险时犯系统性预测错误。基于这一分析，我估计了用算法决策规则替代法官的效果，并发现用算法替代存在系统性预测错误的法官优于现状。

articles.abstract_en: A new form of secured lending using “digital collateral” has recently emerged, most prominently in low- and middle-income countries. Digital collateral relies on lockout technology, which allows the lender to temporarily disable the flow value of the collateral to the borrower without physically repossessing it. We explore this new form of credit in a model and a field experiment using school-fee loans digitally secured with a solar home system. Securing a loan with digital collateral drastically reduced default rates (by 19 percentage points) and increased the lender’s rate of return (by 49 percentage points). Using a variant of the Karlan and Zinman (2009) methodology, we decompose the total effect on repayment and find that roughly two-thirds is attributable to moral hazard, and one-third to adverse selection. In addition, access to digitally secured school-fee loans significantly increased school enrollment and school-related expenditures without detrimental effects on households’ balance sheets.
articles.abstract_cn: 一种使用“数字抵押品”的新型担保贷款形式最近出现，主要在中低收入国家。数字抵押品依赖于锁定技术，该技术允许贷方暂时禁用抵押品对借款人的流动价值，而无需物理收回。我们通过一个模型和一个使用太阳能家庭系统数字担保的学费贷款的实地实验来探索这种新的信贷形式。用数字抵押品担保贷款大幅降低了违约率（降低了19个百分点），并提高了贷方的回报率（提高了49个百分点）。使用Karlan和Zinman（2009）方法的一种变体，我们分解了对还款的总效应，发现大约三分之二归因于道德风险，三分之一归因于逆向选择。此外，获得数字担保的学费贷款显著提高了学校入学率和与学校相关的支出，而对家庭资产负债表没有不利影响。

articles.title_en: The Mortgage Piggy Bank: Building Wealth Through Amortization
articles.title_cn: 抵押贷款储蓄罐：通过分期偿还积累财富
articles.abstract_en: In 2013, the Dutch government mandated that new conforming mortgages must fully amortize. Within a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that the marginal wealth accumulation from amortization is close to one, even five years later. Households purchasing after the reform primarily cut consumption and leisure over other savings, leading to a rise in wealth. This holds if we use life events to instrument for the timing of home purchase. Estimates are similar for seemingly unconstrained households and movers, suggesting a broad applicability of our results. Consistent with a simple model, we find lower estimates for households that appear less financially sophisticated or willing to adjust short-term consumption. Mortgage amortization schedules are among the largest savings plans in the world, and our results highlight their critical importance for household wealth building and macroprudential policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2013年，荷兰政府规定新的合格抵押贷款必须全额分期偿还。在双重差分设计中，我们估计分期偿还带来的边际财富积累接近于一，即使在五年后也是如此。改革后购房的家庭主要减少消费和休闲而非其他储蓄，从而导致财富增加。如果我们使用生活事件作为购房时机的工具变量，这一结论依然成立。对于看似不受约束的家庭和搬家者，估计结果相似，表明我们的结果具有广泛的适用性。与一个简单模型一致，我们发现对于财务知识较少或不愿调整短期消费的家庭，估计值较低。抵押贷款分期偿还计划是世界上最大的储蓄计划之一，我们的结果强调了其对家庭财富积累和宏观审慎政策的关键重要性。

articles.title_en: How the 1963 Equal Pay Act and 1964 Civil Rights Act Shaped the Gender Gap in Pay
articles.title_cn: 1963年《同工同酬法》和1964年《民权法》如何塑造了性别薪酬差距
articles.abstract_en: In the 1960s, two landmark statutes—the Equal Pay and Civil Rights Acts—targeted the long-standing practice of employment discrimination against U.S. women. For the next 15 years, the gender gap in median earnings among full-time, full-year workers changed little, leading many scholars to conclude that the legislation was ineffectual. This article revisits this conclusion using two research designs, which leverage (i) cross-state variation in preexisting state equal pay laws and (ii) variation in the 1960 gender gap across occupation-industry-state-group cells to capture differences in the legislation's incidence. Both designs suggest that federal antidiscrimination legislation led to striking gains in women's relative wages, which were concentrated among below-median wage earners. These wage gains offset preexisting labor market forces, which worked to depress women's relative pay growth, resulting in the apparent stability of the gender gap at the median and mean in the 1960s and 1970s. The data show little evidence of short-term changes in women's employment but suggest that firms reduced their hiring and promotion of women in the medium to long term. The historical record points to the key role of the Equal Pay Act in driving these changes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在1960年，两项具有里程碑意义的法规——《同工同酬法》和《民权法》——针对美国女性长期遭受的就业歧视问题。在接下来的15年里，全职全年工作者中位收入的性别差距变化甚微，导致许多学者认为这些立法效果不彰。本文通过两种研究设计重新审视了这一结论，这两种设计利用（i）各州先前存在的同工同酬法的跨州差异，以及（ii）1960年职业-行业-州组别中性别差距的差异，来捕捉立法影响程度的不同。两种设计均表明，联邦反歧视立法显著提升了女性的相对工资，这些收益集中在收入低于中位数的劳动者中。这些工资收益抵消了先前存在的劳动力市场力量（这些力量倾向于压低女性相对薪酬的增长），从而在1960年和1970年使得性别差距在中位数和均值上看似稳定。数据显示，女性就业在短期内几乎没有变化的证据，但表明企业在中期到长期内减少了女性的招聘和晋升。历史记录指出了《同工同酬法》在推动这些变化中的关键作用。

articles.title_en: Answering the Call of Automation: How the Labor Market Adjusted to Mechanizing Telephone Operation
articles.title_cn: 回应自动化的召唤：劳动力市场如何适应电话操作的机械化
articles.abstract_en: In the early 1900s, telephone operation was among the most common jobs for American women, and telephone operators were ubiquitous. Between 1920 and 1940, AT&T undertook one of the largest automation investments in modern history, replacing operators with mechanical switching technology in over half of the U.S. telephone network. Using variation across U.S. cities in the timing of adoption, we study how this wave of automation affected the labor market for young women. Although automation eliminated most of these jobs, it did not reduce future cohorts’ overall employment: the decline in operators was counteracted by employment growth in middle-skill clerical jobs and lower-skill service jobs, including new categories of work. Using a new genealogy-based census-linking method, we show that incumbent telephone operators were most affected, and a decade later more likely to be in lower-paying occupations or no longer working.
articles.abstract_cn: 在1900年代初，电话操作是美国女性最常见的职业之一，电话接线员无处不在。在1920至1940年间，AT&T进行了现代历史上最大规模的自动化投资之一，用机械交换技术取代了美国电话网络一半以上的接线员。利用美国各城市采用该技术的时机差异，我们研究了这波自动化如何影响年轻女性的劳动力市场。尽管自动化消除了大部分此类工作，但它并未减少未来各队列的总体就业：接线员的减少被中等技能文职工作和低技能服务工作的就业增长所抵消，包括新的工作类别。使用一种基于家谱的人口普查链接新方法，我们表明在职电话接线员受影响最大，十年后更可能从事低薪职业或不再工作。

articles.title_cn: 土地保障与劳动力流动摩擦
articles.abstract_en: Frictions that impede the mobility of workers across occupations and space are a prominent feature of developing countries. We disentangle the role of insecure property rights from other labor-mobility frictions for the reallocation of labor from agriculture to nonagriculture and from rural to urban areas. We combine rich household and individual-level panel data from China and an equilibrium quantitative framework featuring sorting of workers across locations and occupations. We explicitly model the farming household and the endogenous decisions of who operates the family farm and who potentially migrates, capturing an additional channel of selection in the household. We find that land insecurity has substantial negative effects on agricultural productivity and structural change, raising the share of rural households operating farms by over 40 percentage points and depressing agricultural productivity by more than 20%. Comparatively, these quantitative effects are as large as those from all residual labor-mobility frictions. We measure a sharp reduction in overall labor-mobility barriers over 2004–2018 in the Chinese economy, all accounted for by improved land security, consistent with reforms covering rural land in China during the period. JEL Codes: O11, O14, O4, E02, Q1.
articles.abstract_cn: 阻碍工人跨职业和跨空间流动的摩擦是发展中国家的一个显著特征。我们区分了不安全的产权与其他劳动力流动摩擦在劳动力从农业向非农业、从农村向城市地区重新配置中的作用。我们结合了中国丰富的家庭和个人层面面板数据，以及一个包含工人跨地点和职业分类的均衡定量框架。我们明确建模了农户家庭以及谁经营家庭农场、谁可能迁移的内生决策，捕捉了家庭中额外的选择渠道。我们发现，土地不安全对农业生产率和结构变化具有显著的负面影响，使经营农场的农村家庭比例提高了超过40个百分点，并使农业生产率降低了超过20%。相比之下，这些定量效应与所有剩余劳动力流动摩擦的效应一样大。我们测度了2004-2018年间中国经济中总体劳动力流动障碍的急剧减少，这完全归因于土地保障的改善，与这一时期中国农村土地改革相一致。JEL代码：O11，O14，O4，E02，Q1。

articles.title_en: Understanding Markets with Socially Responsible Consumers
articles.title_cn: 理解具有社会责任感的消费者的市场
articles.abstract_en: Many consumers care about climate change and other externalities associated with their purchases. We analyze the behavior and market effects of such “socially responsible consumers” in three parts. First, we develop a flexible theoretical framework to study competitive equilibria with rational consequentialist consumers. In violation of price taking, equilibrium feedback nontrivially dampens the impact of a person’s consumption on aggregate consumption, undermining the motive to mitigate. This leads to a new type of market failure, where even consumers who fully “internalize the externality” overconsume externality-generating goods. At the same time, socially responsible consumers change the relative effectiveness of taxes, caps, and other policies in lowering the externality. Second, since consumer beliefs about and preferences over their market impacts play a crucial role in our framework, we investigate them empirically via a tailored survey. Consistent with our model, consumers are often consequentialist, and many believe that they have a dampened impact on aggregate consumption. Inconsistent with our model, however, we also find many respondents who expect to have a one-to-one impact on aggregate consumption. Third, therefore, we analyze how such “naive” consumers modify our theoretical conclusions. They consume less than rational consumers in a single-good economy, but may consume more in a multigood economy with cross-market spillovers. A mix of naive and rational consumers may yield the worst outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多消费者关心气候变化及其购买行为带来的其他外部性。我们从三个部分分析这类“具有社会责任感的消费者”的行为和市场效应。首先，我们开发了一个灵活的理论框架来研究理性后果主义消费者的竞争均衡。违背价格接受行为，均衡反馈非平凡地削弱了个人消费对总消费的影响，削弱了缓解动机。这导致了一种新型的市场失灵，即使是完全“内化外部性”的消费者也会过度消费产生外部性的商品。同时，具有社会责任感的消费者改变了税收、限额和其他政策在降低外部性方面的相对有效性。其次，由于消费者对其市场影响的信念和偏好在我们的框架中起着关键作用，我们通过一项定制调查对其进行了实证研究。与我们的模型一致，消费者通常是后果主义的，许多人认为他们对总消费的影响被削弱了。然而，与我们的模型不一致的是，我们也发现许多受访者期望对总消费产生一对一的影响。因此，第三，我们分析了这种“天真”的消费者如何修改我们的理论结论。在单一商品经济中，他们比理性消费者消费更少，但在具有跨市场溢出效应的多商品经济中，他们可能消费更多。天真和理性消费者的混合可能产生最糟糕的结果。
